title: FakeMetrics
excerpt: Mock dashboard pictures for slides, demos, and jokes. The numbers are made up.
content_html:
Mock dashboards for decks and jokes

Pick a platform, type placeholder numbers, and download a picture for a slide, a demo, or a joke. None of it is a real account

Pick a platform and we'll open the editor

Made-up numbers on copies of familiar dashboards

Sample mockups
